axiom_audit_result: Every theorem depends on a subset of [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]; several need only [propext] or no axioms. Lean.ofReduceBool appears nowhere, so no native_decide is involved.

engineering_defects_recorded.detail: forall z : Fin 6 -> Fin 2 forces the Fintype instance for a function type; the kernel term is enormous. The first bridge exhausted 64 GB of RAM on it. The same facts stated over six explicit Fin 2 arguments compile in seconds. Rule: quantify over elements, not over functions, then lift with an eta lemma.

After fin_cases the index is <k,_> and the if-condition is a Fin.val equality; both need reduceIte and Fin.mk_zero, which a closed simp only list does not invoke. Second time this fin_cases trap bit the corpus; the first was the twelve Fin.mk companion lemmas in V2.
Its last component compares responseWitnessSpan, a difference of two responses, not osc. Three errors had this single root. Reading the definition would have cost one grep.
div_lt_div_of_pos_left concludes a/b < a/c, same numerator; the goal had the same denominator. Replaced by two local helpers proved with linarith, since division by a numeral is linear.
rw with an integer equation cannot match a real literal. Fixed by four intermediate lemmas stating the residual extremes directly over R.

Whether the bound fails exactly for even m. The derivation 2k/(m-1) assumes a tie point whose loss spectrum has step delta_square; at m=4 the tie points found have step delta_square/2, so the parity statement is not established.
